type.name: Element
type.description: One chemical element, asked one way: its symbol, its name, where it sits on the table, what sits in a highlighted cell, its numbers, its atomic mass, its family and block, or its electron configuration. Every answer ends on the element's tile and its place in the table.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: What the card asks: symbol, name, locate, identify, numbers, mass, family or config.

fields.name: mass
fields.description: Standard atomic weight, or the mass number of the most stable isotope.

fields.name: massText
fields.description: The mass as printed on the tile; [brackets] for elements with no stable isotope.

fields.name: massTolerance
fields.description: How far off a mass answer may be.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Empty for the lanthanides and actinides.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Accepted blocks (two for La, Lu, Ac, Lr, whose block is still argued).

fields.name: configAlt
fields.description: Other accepted configurations, where predictions disagree.

fields.name: predicted
fields.description: Configuration and family are predictions, not measurements.
